page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the opening lines of the second half of the paragraph. The running head is above the text, and the page number is at the head. No catchword or signature.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif· inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: alias hanc jactabat praecipue, quòd civitas imperium omne, quod quoquo modo ex Henrici Imp. dono profluxisse videri poterat, redemisse se pactione nuper censebat, Episcopus autem ad urbanam Praefecturam pactionem non pertinere contendebat, praefecturamque ajebat ab antecessoribus suis dari solitum, à se quoque dari oportere. Nec ante destitit armis civitatem premere, omnia circum circà infesta ei facere, majora minitari, quàm ad dictatas conditiones descendere eam compulisset. Conditiones hæ fuêre. Exu-Transfa-tio duplex cum Friderico Blan-ckenhemio[?]les ad sua, ut tum erant, redirent, nec actiones de damno haberent: Canon quinquennio non solutus collegio ob bellum, statim solveretur: Civitas Episcopo jus Praefecturae suburbanae cederet; is praefectum pro arbitrio daret, qui sedem & tribunal haberet in urbe; id est, ut verbo dicam, pactio prior cum collegio esset irrita. Id pridie Michaelis anni M. cccc. v. confectum. Triduo post, de urbano jure sic porrò transfactum: Civitas Groninga e numero civium suorum Sculthe-tium[?], id est, praefectum ederet quem vellet, munus ei abrogaret, successorem daret, con-tinuaret,

page.notes: Running head and the note's last word ("Blankenhemio") are uncertain. The running head is read as "De Agro Frif· inter Lavic. & Amaf."; the "f" forms could be long s. "Sculthe-tium" is read from a line break where the letter looks like "f" and could be "Sculthetium" split differently. The margin note is split across five lines ("Transfa-", "tio duplex", "cum Fride", "rico Blan-", "ckenhemio") and is joined here. Printing errors left as printed: "fuêre" and "hæ" are copied as set.
